finalText:
I couldn't read the first section of the Q3 plan. I attached to the browser, opened `http://127.0.0.1:8899/`, and clicked the "Q3 plan" link. The URL changed to `#q3`, but the page shows no document content. The page HTML contains only the heading, the two links, the share button, and one paragraph.
